paper_section: Section 6.2 and Appendix B: Real-Data NSW Archive

source.outcome: 1978 earnings in thousands of US dollars (re78 / 1000)

local_object_protocol.distance: Euclidean distance in eight standardized covariates
local_object_protocol.anchor_filter: exclude the top five percent of center norms and neighborhood radii, then deterministic farthest-point coverage
local_object_protocol.effect: local randomized treated-minus-control difference in mean 1978 earnings, measured in thousands of dollars
local_object_protocol.standard_error: Welch standard error for the two local arms
local_object_protocol.radius: root mean squared standardized distance to local context

blind_evaluation: held-out effect estimates and held-out standard errors are not read by any estimator; both are retained only as noisy evaluation references

method_protocol.atlas: semantic candidate retrieval followed by regularized convex composition in all covariates, overlap, and radius; reject when the observable certificate exceeds the fixed tolerance
method_protocol.atlas_no_rejection: same point weights as ATLAS, forced publication, and a certificate with only the prespecified no-rejection bias fraction
method_protocol.semantic_forced: inverse-distance weights on demographics only: age, education, race indicators, marital status, and no-degree status
method_protocol.global_mean: uniform mean of all remaining local effects

metric_scope: MAE, sign, and coverage use the noisy held-out local contrast as the reference; they are not ground-truth subgroup-effect metrics

target_level_outputs.scope: shared held-out targets for all five methods; used to plot empirical absolute-error distributions

reproduction_scope: the focal paper does not report neighborhood size, anchor selection, coordinate split, split seeds, or certificate tuning; this fixed protocol reproduces the experiment structure, not Table 3 values exactly
